fixture.byteOracle: monotonic deterministic frame and byte intervals recorded by the external controller
fixture.acceptedWatermark: exclusive end A of complete bounded writer calls that returned before SIGKILL; an in-progress call is excluded

binaryEncodingPrimitives.lp16Ascii: U16BE byte length followed by exactly that many 7-bit ASCII bytes

definitions.semanticCommitPoint: successful return of SQLite endTransaction() after durable data, key-envelope and authenticated manifest/checkpoint publication
definitions.controllerCommitEvent: evidence emitted only after semantic commit; not part of commit definition
definitions.committedPrefix: longest gap-free plaintext interval [0,C) reconstructed from the intersection of durable SQLite rows and authenticated manifest/checkpoint
definitions.recoveredAuthenticatedPrefix: longest gap-free oracle-equal interval [0,R) composed only of bytes returned by successfully completed authenticated reads
definitions.controllerLedgerRole: independent cross-check and external rollback anchor

keyModel.derivedKeyPerStream: one HKDF-derived 16-byte AES-GCM key for the ciphertext stream

checkpointModel.name: DURABLE_ONE_SEGMENT_LOOKAHEAD
checkpointModel.qDefinition: count of fully output non-final 4096-byte ciphertext segments durably present in the prefix

newRunSequence: fail with KEY_REF_COLLISION if the alias or key-reference namespace is occupied

keyConfirmation.purpose: distinguish a resolved-but-replaced alias from an intact alias followed by target-envelope authentication failure

classificationPrecedence.condition: new run finds an existing alias or occupied key-reference namespace
expected alias, key reference or key envelope is absent
key envelope is present but its expected length, SHA-256, binary encoding or parser validation fails
alias is available, key confirmation succeeds and the structurally valid expected envelope fails AEAD, AAD or tag authentication
alias resolves and the stored length/hash-valid key-confirmation ciphertext proves replacement or mismatch

requiredForEveryFinalAndTemporaryPattern: canonical containment beneath the active run root
no symlink at any component or leaf

reconciliationStates.TEMP_ONLY: uncommitted artifact; not published; not committed; after canonical containment, lstat, regular-file and no-symlink validation move it through the quarantine transaction
reconciliationStates.TEMP_AND_FINAL: collision; never overwrite the final; after canonical containment, lstat, regular-file and no-symlink validation move the temp through the quarantine transaction
reconciliationStates.FINAL_ONLY: validate against the authenticated manifest/checkpoint and exact SQLite identity after canonical containment, lstat, regular-file and no-symlink validation
reconciliationStates.SQLITE_POINTS_TO_TEMP: split-brain failure; the temp is not committed; never rename, relabel, publish or promote it by name
reconciliationStates.UNKNOWN_OR_NON_ALLOWLISTED_NAME: fail closed; after canonical containment, lstat, regular-file and no-symlink validation move a regular object through the quarantine transaction; unsafe path/type is an error

streamingSetup: SSET-01 exclusive-create and write stream key-envelope temp
SSET-02 fsync stream key-envelope temp file
SSET-03 collision-check then rename stream key-envelope temp to immutable final
SSET-04 fsync stream key-envelope parent directory
SSET-05 exclusive-create and write initial stream ciphertext temp
SSET-06 fsync initial stream ciphertext temp file
SSET-07 collision-check then rename stream ciphertext temp to immutable final
SSET-08 fsync stream ciphertext parent directory
SSET-09 continue all later writes through the append-only stream ciphertext descriptor that remained open across the temp-to-final rename
streamingCheckpointGeneration: SCHK-01 fsync the open append-only stream ciphertext descriptor
SCHK-02 create a fresh checkpoint keyset and serialize its encrypted envelope in memory
SCHK-03 exclusive-create and write checkpoint key-envelope temp
SCHK-04 fsync checkpoint key-envelope temp file
SCHK-05 collision-check then rename checkpoint key-envelope temp to immutable final
SCHK-06 fsync checkpoint key-envelope parent directory
SCHK-07 encrypt checkpoint then exclusive-create and write checkpoint ciphertext temp
SCHK-08 fsync checkpoint ciphertext temp file
SCHK-09 collision-check then rename checkpoint ciphertext temp to immutable final
SCHK-10 fsync checkpoint ciphertext parent directory
SCHK-11 write exact final identities in the SQLite non-exclusive durable transaction
SCHK-12 successful SQLite endTransaction return is the semantic commit
SCHK-13 emit the controller evidence event after semantic commit
microfileGeneration: MICRO-P01 create a fresh microfile keyset and serialize its encrypted envelope in memory
MICRO-P02 exclusive-create and write microfile key-envelope temp
MICRO-P03 fsync microfile key-envelope temp file
MICRO-P04 collision-check then rename microfile key-envelope temp to immutable final
MICRO-P05 fsync microfile key-envelope parent directory
MICRO-P06 Aead.encrypt returns then exclusive-create and write microfile ciphertext temp
MICRO-P07 fsync microfile ciphertext temp file
MICRO-P08 collision-check then rename microfile ciphertext temp to immutable final
MICRO-P09 fsync microfile ciphertext parent directory
MICRO-P10 create a fresh manifest keyset and serialize its encrypted envelope in memory
MICRO-P11 exclusive-create and write manifest key-envelope temp
MICRO-P12 fsync manifest key-envelope temp file
MICRO-P13 collision-check then rename manifest key-envelope temp to immutable final
MICRO-P14 fsync manifest key-envelope parent directory
MICRO-P15 encrypt manifest then exclusive-create and write manifest ciphertext temp
MICRO-P16 fsync manifest ciphertext temp file
MICRO-P17 collision-check then rename manifest ciphertext temp to immutable final
MICRO-P18 fsync manifest ciphertext parent directory
MICRO-P19 write both key envelopes, both ciphertext finals and exact hashes in the SQLite non-exclusive durable transaction
MICRO-P20 successful SQLite endTransaction return is the semantic commit
MICRO-P21 emit the controller evidence event after semantic commit

storageProtocol.streamSpecialization: stream ciphertext is initially published under the immutable final name while its descriptor remains open; later append checkpoints fsync that append-only descriptor before immutable checkpoint publication

processingIntentId.inputEncoding: LP16(protocolId) || LP16(candidateId) || runId[16] || U32BE(unitIndex) || U64BE(plaintextStartInclusive) || U64BE(plaintextEndExclusive) || ciphertextSha256[32]

freshPreflight.compileOptionsCanonicalization: exact rows sorted lexicographically, UTF-8 encoded, joined by LF and terminated by one LF

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: bounded plaintext write returned; no complete downstream 4096-byte ciphertext segment callback yet and no checkpoint sequence step SCHK-01 started
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: bounded plaintext accepted into unit buffer; MICRO-P06 Aead.encrypt() not called

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: harness-owned downstream ciphertext OutputStream callback received next segment bytes and pauses before delegate write; SCHK-01 not started
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICROFILE_AFTER_AEAD_RETURN_BEFORE_TEMP_WRITE: MICRO-P06 Aead.encrypt() returned complete ciphertext in harness memory; mapped temp ciphertext does not exist and has not been written

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: downstream full-segment write and public plaintext write returned; SCHK-01 stream-descriptor fsync not started
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P06 mapped temp ciphertext write completed; MICRO-P07 fsync not started

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: SCHK-01 append-only ciphertext fsync returned for q; SCHK-02 checkpoint keyset creation not started
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P07 temp ciphertext fsync returned; MICRO-P08 collision-check/rename not started

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: SCHK-06 checkpoint key envelope is immutable and directory-durable; SCHK-07 checkpoint ciphertext encryption/temp write not started
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P09 microfile ciphertext final and parent directory are durable; MICRO-P10 manifest keyset creation not started

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: SCHK-07 checkpoint ciphertext temp write returned; SCHK-08 file fsync not started
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P14 manifest key envelope is immutable and directory-durable; MICRO-P15 manifest encryption/temp write not started

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: SCHK-08 checkpoint temp fsync returned; SCHK-09 collision-check/rename not started
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P16 manifest ciphertext temp fsync returned; MICRO-P17 collision-check/rename not started

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: SCHK-10 checkpoint ciphertext final and parent directory are durable; SCHK-11 SQLite transaction not begun
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P18 manifest ciphertext final and parent directory are durable; MICRO-P19 SQLite transaction not begun

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: SCHK-11 exact final identities written in open non-exclusive SQLite transaction; SCHK-12 endTransaction() not called
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P19 both key envelopes and both ciphertext finals written in open non-exclusive SQLite transaction; MICRO-P20 endTransaction() not called

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: SCHK-12 endTransaction() returned; SCHK-13 controller event not emitted
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P20 endTransaction() returned; MICRO-P21 controller event not emitted

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: SCHK-13 controller event durably acknowledged and next bounded plaintext call active after at least one semantic commit
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: MICRO-P21 controller event durably acknowledged and next microfile unit active after at least one semantic commit

strata.REC-STREAM-TINK: immutable K12-STREAM-V0.3 seed; recovery paused after quarantine intent commit and before rename
strata.REC-MICROFILE-TINK: immutable K12-MICROFILE-V0.3 seed; recovery paused after quarantine intent commit and before rename

cases.injection: bit flip in committed ciphertext
cases.expected: authentication failure at affected unit; earlier prefix preserved; affected and later state quarantined

cases.injection: alter manifest or checkpoint ciphertext or tag
cases.expected: generation rejected; last valid jointly durable prefix retained; affected generation classified as explicit corruption

cases.injection: alter SQLite filename, length, digest or range
cases.expected: split-brain; data not relabeled committed; no deletion

cases.injection: swap microfile ciphertext with another entry or key reference
cases.expected: digest/AAD/envelope binding rejects swap; no cross-unit decrypt; no skip

cases.injection: duplicate, gap, reorder or remove manifest entry or unit
cases.expected: strict parser rejects generation; no implicit sorting; no compaction; no later-unit promotion

cases.injection: cross-run or cross-generation replay
cases.expected: run, generation, range and previous-digest AAD rejects replay

cases.injection: truncate uncommitted tail
cases.expected: committed prefix preserved; tail explicitly classified

cases.injection: truncate committed unit
cases.expected: FAIL for committed loss; no shorter healthy relabel

cases.injection: append unauthenticated bytes
cases.expected: appended bytes rejected and quarantined; prefix unchanged

cases.injection: missing, invalidated or unusable run alias
cases.expected: KEY_UNAVAILABLE; artifacts retained

cases.injection: missing expected run key reference or run-level key envelope
cases.expected: KEY_UNAVAILABLE; no replacement key

cases.injection: missing candidate data key envelope
cases.expected: KEY_UNAVAILABLE; no skip across a hole and no replacement key

cases.injection: alias resolves but stored length/hash-valid key-confirmation ciphertext proves replacement or mismatch
cases.expected: KEY_UNAVAILABLE_KEY_MISMATCH; replacement is never accepted; regeneration is forbidden

cases.injection: present expected key envelope with wrong length, wrong recorded SHA-256, invalid binary encoding or parser-invalid bytes
cases.expected: CORRUPT_KEY_ENVELOPE; no AEAD attempt and no keyset use

cases.injection: copy a structurally valid envelope from another target, update the expected length and SHA-256, and retain the wrong target-bound AAD
cases.expected: KEY_ENVELOPE_AUTH_FAILURE; key confirmation succeeds and no keyset is used

cases.injection: start a new run with a preexisting alias or occupied key-reference namespace
cases.expected: KEY_REF_COLLISION; publication does not start and no existing key/reference is overwritten

cases.injection: file durable and SQLite row absent
cases.expected: authenticated orphan remains uncommitted; deterministic reconciliation moves it through the quarantine transaction

cases.injection: SQLite committed row and file missing
cases.expected: explicit split-brain and FAIL for committed loss

cases.injection: manifest or checkpoint ahead of SQLite
cases.expected: generation retained for reconciliation; never implicit commit

cases.injection: SQLite ahead of authenticated publication
cases.expected: explicit split-brain; last jointly durable prefix only

cases.injection: temp file or generation remains
cases.expected: deterministic temp classification; no final-path overwrite

cases.injection: replace current manifest or checkpoint with older valid generation
cases.expected: external ledger detects rollback; no global anti-rollback claim without ledger

cases.injection: restore full older valid app snapshot
cases.expected: external ledger detects full-snapshot rollback; local chain alone explicitly insufficient

cases.injection: malformed, oversized or trailing-byte manifest or unsafe, symlink or path-traversal relative name
cases.expected: malformed input maps to MALFORMED_MANIFEST; oversized input maps to OVERSIZED_MANIFEST; an unsafe/symlink/traversal name maps to UNSAFE_PATH; no unsafe object opened

cases.injection: unknown or orphan regular file
cases.expected: intent and hashes recorded; move only to contained app-private quarantine

cases.injection: hard kill during quarantine move
cases.expected: next recovery converges to exactly one item; zero loss; zero duplicates

cases.injection: interrupt each intent, rename, directory-fsync and completion boundary
cases.expected: deterministic reconciliation maps the observed durable state to exactly one named terminal state selected from [COMPLETED, RETRY_REQUIRED]

cases.injection: run recovery twice without mutation
cases.expected: byte-identical prefix and stable classifications and intent IDs

cases.injection: hard kill recovery and recover again
cases.expected: canonical uninterrupted result; zero duplicate intents; zero missing intents

cases.injection: kill after successful SQLite endTransaction return and before controller event
cases.expected: local C remains committed and reconstructible; ledger reports event gap and never downgrades commit
